stages.name: Email Bombing Smokescreen
observables: Hundreds of 'Welcome' or 'Confirm Subscription' emails within 24 hours
Automated sign-ups for newsletters and mailing lists
High volume of messages from legitimate but unsolicited domains

stages.name: Hidden Account Takeover
observables: Recovery email or phone number updates

stages.name: Mailbox Rule Manipulation
observables: Creation of new inbox rules to redirect alerts
Moving security notifications to RSS or Deleted folders

stages.name: Tech Support Scam Execution
observables: Installation of AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or other RMM tools
Process execution of remote access binaries
Network connections to known RMM control planes

scenario.summary: Attackers flood a victim's inbox with hundreds of automated sign-up emails to bury legitimate security alerts. This smokescreen masks unauthorized account takeovers, fraudulent purchases, or password changes occurring simultaneously, and can also serve as a precursor to tech support scams.

meta.rationale: Focus first on users with sensitive identity changes in the last 14 days, then expand to mailbox volume analysis for those accounts.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker is using an email sign-up flood as a smokescreen to hide security alerts while they perform account takeovers and install remote access tools via tech support scams.

scope_hosts.description: Optional list of hostnames to focus the process hunt.

bomb_threshold.description: Number of total sign-up emails within a day to flag as a potential flood.

blind_spots.risk: A flood that bypasses the primary inbox or is handled by a local Outlook rule might be missed by server-side auditing.
blind_spots.question: whether we can see floods targeting sub-folders or those processed by local client rules
blind_spots.requires: comprehensive mailbox auditing for all folders
blind_spots.remediation: Enable advanced mailbox auditing in M365/Workspace to capture all folder moves and deletions.

blind_spots.risk: The initial social engineering call is invisible to endpoint and cloud logs, preventing early detection of the scam phase.
blind_spots.question: whether the victim received a call from the fraudster prior to installing the RMM tool
blind_spots.remediation: Correlate external VoIP call logs with employee ID profiles.

hunt.name: Email Bombing and Identity Takeover Correlation
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the coordination between a distraction-based denial-of-service (email bombing) and unauthorized identity changes. Attackers flood a victim's mailbox with automated sign-up emails to bury legitimate alerts from banks or identity providers. The hunt flows through a phased analysis of initial account scoping, mailbox floods, authentication risks, and follow-on evasion tactics like mailbox rule manipulation or unauthorized remote management software execution.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, activity_name, time FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id IN (3, 4, 99) AND (LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%mfa%' OR LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%factor%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find users associated with sensitive account modifications like password resets or MFA changes that may be targets of a smokescreen.
config.expected_signal: A list of users who underwent identity modifications. This scopes the initial investigation to potential takeover victims.

primitive_config.label: Scope sensitive account changes
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, activity_name, time FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id IN (3, 4, 99) AND (LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%mfa%' OR LOWER(activity_name) LIKE '%factor%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of users who underwent identity modifications. This scopes the initial investigation to potential takeover victims.

config.content: SELECT COUNT(*) as volume, date(internal_date) as received_on, user_id FROM googleworkspace_gmail_message WHERE internal_date >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_id, received_on HAVING volume > {{bomb_threshold}} ORDER BY volume DESC
config.description: Identify potential email bombs by searching for rare volume spikes per user.
config.expected_signal: Users receiving an abnormal amount of mail in a single day. Silence proves absence only if all mailboxes were scanned.

primitive_config.label: Detect aggregate mailbox floods
primitive_config.content: SELECT COUNT(*) as volume, date(internal_date) as received_on, user_id FROM googleworkspace_gmail_message WHERE internal_date >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_id, received_on HAVING volume > {{bomb_threshold}} ORDER BY volume DESC
primitive_config.expected: Users receiving an abnormal amount of mail in a single day. Silence proves absence only if all mailboxes were scanned.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, device_hostname, risk_state, status_detail, src_endpoint_ip, src_location_country, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (risk_state != 'none' OR status_id = 2) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC

config.objective: Identify users with concurrent high-volume email events and sensitive identity changes. Correlate timestamps to determine if the flood acted as a distraction for a specific security alert or auth failure.
config.description: Determine if the inbox flood and account changes represent a coordinated smokescreen.
config.expected_signal: A prioritized list of users showing high-volume email floods concurrent with identity changes.
config.success_criteria: A per-user confidence score for an active distraction campaign.

nodes.label: Detect mailbox rule and filter manipulation

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, target_modified_property_new_values, time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE ((api_operation IN ('New-InboxRule', 'Set-InboxRule') AND (LOWER(target_modified_property_new_values) LIKE '%move%' OR LOWER(target_modified_property_new_values) LIKE '%delete%')) OR (api_operation = 'CREATE_SETTINGS_FILTER')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify rules or filters created to move or delete alerts, ensuring the distraction remains permanent.
config.expected_signal: Rules or Google filters configured to silently process incoming mail, appearing after a flood.

primitive_config.expected: Rules or Google filters configured to silently process incoming mail, appearing after a flood.
